name: t2v-desk
prompt: A man in his late twenties with warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, thin round tortoiseshell glasses, light stubble, cream chunky knit sweater over a white t-shirt, sits at a light-oak desk in a bright minimal apartment with a silver laptop. He glances at the camera with a small relaxed smile, then presses a key combination and types a short question, then leans back, satisfied, reading. Morning sun through sheer curtains, handheld push-in, 35mm film look, realistic. No text, no logos.

name: t2v-cafe
prompt: A man in his late twenties with warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, thin round tortoiseshell glasses, light stubble, cream chunky knit sweater, sits by a big window in a sunny neighbourhood cafe with a silver laptop and a flat white. He types a quick question, reads, raises his eyebrows with a pleased nod, and sips the coffee. Slow handheld arc, warm afternoon light, blurred patrons, 35mm, realistic. No text, no logos.

name: t2v-train

No text, no logos.

name: t2v-night

Warm desk lamp, slow push-in, 35mm, realistic. No text, no logos.

name: t2v-hello
prompt: Selfie phone video: a friendly man in his late twenties with warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, thin round tortoiseshell glasses, light stubble and a cream knit sweater holds the phone at arm's length in a bright plant-filled loft, waves and grins at the camera, turns to show a silver laptop on his desk, then turns back with a thumbs up. Handheld, natural light, realistic. No text, no logos.
